data.title: Al-Yamamah Enterprise Employment Application and Terms

planted.text: All candidate information and application files submitted through this portal shall be retained indefinitely within our archival databases to support our continuous talent mapping initiatives, and the company reserves the right to maintain these records permanently without a scheduled date for deletion.

Applicants retain the right to be informed of the specific purposes and legal justifications for data collection, to access their submitted records, to request corrections or updates to inaccurate details, and to request the destruction of information that is no longer required for active recruitment.

Processing of candidate records and any subsequent adjustment to the scope of their utilization shall proceed based on the understanding established at the time of submission, recognizing that adjustments to authorization may be communicated through standard administrative channels.

neutral: Definitions: In this application form, "Company" refers to Al-Yamamah Enterprise, and "Applicant" refers to the individual submitting employment credentials.

Intellectual Property: All materials, designs, and code samples submitted by the applicant as part of the assessment process remain the property of the respective creator, granting the company a limited license for evaluation purposes only.
Fees and Payment: There are no application, processing, or placement fees required from candidates at any stage of the recruitment process.
Term and Termination: This application process commences upon submission and terminates automatically upon the final hiring decision or formal withdrawal by the applicant.

Limitation of Liability: The company shall not be held financially or legally liable for any technical failures, transmission delays, or data corruption occurring during the online submission of employment materials.
Governing Law: This agreement and any related recruitment disputes shall be interpreted and governed by the laws applicable in the headquarters jurisdiction of the company.
Delivery: Official communications, interview invitations, and formal offers shall be deemed delivered when transmitted to the electronic mail address provided by the applicant.
Notices: All formal inquiries regarding the status of an application must be directed exclusively to the designated human resources contact portal specified on the company website.
